title: Kyun Ki Har Ek Saas Zaroori Hoti Hai
desc: Mausam is educated, but this irks her mother-in-law Dhaneshwari. Distraught, Mausam vents to her deceased grandmother-in-law's photo, who then possesses her to teach Dhaneshwari a lesson.

title: Love Marriage
desc: A man and woman who deeply love each other face societal challenges and must defeat the animosity between their families to get married.

title: Badhaai Ho
desc: Nakul, a 25-year-old man, is shocked to discover that his mother is pregnant. His struggle to come to terms with the news puts his relationship with his girlfriend in jeopardy.

title: Mai Babuji Ke Aashirwad
desc: A poor couple adopts and raises a boy. However, years later, his biological mother turns up and reveals that he's the son of a wealthy businessman.

title: Akshara
desc: After marrying Vijay, Akshara persuades her grandmother to let her continue teaching. With Vijay's support, she secures a job at a government school, which happens to be near an international school.

title: Karz Virasat Ke
desc: Kashi, a young man estranged from his father, falls in love with a beautiful woman, Suman. However, the latter's family disapproves of their relationship.

title: Bhakti Dhaam
desc: A compilation of uplifting religious melodies and devotional tracks is played back-to-back to create a serene atmosphere for people seeking daily spiritual guidance.
